A Serving Has: 320 mg EPA / 200 mg DHA
paragraphs: The Benefits of Omega-3 Fatty Acids

Spectrum Essentials® Fish Oil contains the Omega-3 essential fatty acids EPA and DHA. These vital nutrients help maintain cardiovascular function while supporting the normal development of the brain, eyes and nervous system.

Spectrum Essentials® Fish Oil comes from non-threatened species of wild-caught fish harvested through sustainable fishing practices. Our fish oil conforms to GOED Omega-3's stringent purity standards and is also tested by independent laboratories to meet California Prop 65 and European Union defined limits for contaminants.
